name: dogecoin-payment-button
title: Dogecoin Payment Button
author: Simon Betton
description: A Button that opens a Send me Dogecoin dialog with BIP44 address discovery, optional mempool payment detection, QR code, and copy support. Prefer resolving the account xpub on the server.
docs: Set DOGECOIN_XPUB to a dedicated Dogecoin BIP44 account public key at m/44'/3'/0' (dgub or xpub). Prefer resolving addresses in a Server Action and passing only the address (or a resolver) to the client. Browser-side xpub derivation exposes the full account receive chain to visitors. For optional mempool watching, keep ONLYDOGE_API_TOKEN server-side and proxy SSE through a same-origin route; pass mempoolWatch.endpoint to the button.
